CHANGED.subject: Your Glazecalc password was changed

CHANGE_NOTICE.subject: A new email was requested for your Glazecalc account

CONFIRM_CHANGE.subject: Confirm your new email for Glazecalc

CONFIRM_CHOICES.off: never ask. Changes from apps and access tokens are made at once
CONFIRM_CHOICES.removals: ask before removals only: moving a record to the Trash, or taking a material off the materials on hand. Other changes from apps and access tokens are made at once

CONFIRM_LOOSENED.subject: Glazecalc now asks less before apps change your records

CONNECTION_MADE.subject: An app was connected to your Glazecalc account
CONNECTION_MADE.opening: An app was connected to the Glazecalc account {account} on {date} at {time} (UTC).
CONNECTION_MADE.selfDescribed: It registered itself, so its name is only what it says about itself.
CONNECTION_MADE.loopback: It receives the answer on the computer it was connected from ({host}).
CONNECTION_MADE.read: It can read the recipes, notebook, materials, shelf and settings saved in the account. It cannot change anything.
CONNECTION_MADE.write: It can read the recipes, notebook, materials, shelf and settings saved in the account, and for {days} days it can also change them: make and change records, and move them to the Trash. Every change keeps a version of the record as it was, so you can undo it on the website.

DELETED.subject: Your Glazecalc account was deleted
DELETED.text:
The Glazecalc account {account} has been deleted, with everything saved in it: recipes, materials, firings, notes and settings. It cannot be undone.

Copies in the site backups are deleted as the backups expire, within {days} days.

You can make a new account at any time.

-- 
Glazecalc, {app}

MFA_ADDED.subject: A sign-in step was added to your Glazecalc account

MFA_CLEAR_NOTICE.subject: Two-step sign-in on your Glazecalc account will be turned off

MFA_OFF.subject: Two-step sign-in was turned off on your Glazecalc account

MFA_REMOVED.subject: A sign-in step was removed from your Glazecalc account

PROVIDER_LINKED.subject: A new way to sign in was added to your Glazecalc account

PROVIDER_UNLINKED.subject: A way to sign in was removed from your Glazecalc account

RECOVERY_NEW.subject: New recovery codes for your Glazecalc account

RECOVERY_USED.subject: A recovery code was used on your Glazecalc account

RESET.subject: Reset your Glazecalc password

RESET_STOPPED.subject: Your Glazecalc password was changed
RESET_STOPPED.opening: The password for the Glazecalc account {account} was just reset, and every device that was signed in has been signed out.
RESET_STOPPED.stopped: In case someone else had the old password, the reset also stopped these:
RESET_STOPPED.tokens: - The access tokens and connected apps that could reach your saved work ({count}). If you still need one, make a new token on your account page at {page}
RESET_STOPPED.providers: - Signing in with {providers}, which you can link again on your account page at {page}
RESET_STOPPED.shareLinks: - The links you had made to share recipes. You can make new ones from each recipe.

SECOND_STEP_UNFINISHED.subject: Someone entered your Glazecalc password but did not finish signing in

TOKEN_EXPIRING.subject: An access token for your Glazecalc account expires soon
TOKEN_EXPIRING.text:
The access token named "{name}" on the Glazecalc account {account} stops working on {date}.

If you still use it, make a new token before then at {page} and give it to your assistant or script in place of the old one. If you no longer use it, there is nothing to do.

-- 
Glazecalc, {app}

TOKEN_MADE.subject: A new access token for your Glazecalc account

TOKEN_MADE_WRITE.subject: A new access token that can change your Glazecalc records

VERIFY.subject: Confirm your email for Glazecalc
